count_definitions: Controls count all simulator steps on verified query reward tapes. Decision commands count consumed steps at logged decisions, including unchanged steps. Changed commands differ in at least one component from that event's bounded nominal action. Calibrations are separate.
pairing: Rescues and losses count layouts switching from failure to success and success to failure. Deltas are success-rate differences. Intervals resample paired layouts 10,000 times with seed 42710300. One-choice hindsight takes the per-layout maximum of continue, correct and cue. Online branches can intervene at every later replan and have a different attainable success rate.
